fields.description: What this society calls this template. Display only.
fields.label: Template Name

fields.description: The stable business key, and the docname. Configuration elsewhere points at a template by this key (a membership type's template_key, for instance), so renaming the template's label never breaks what refers to it.
fields.label: Template Key

fields.description: Which kind of template this is. A configurable set, not a code vocabulary: the renderer treats every category identically and no source file branches on the value.
fields.label: Category

fields.description: An inactive template refuses to render, so retiring one is a settings change rather than a deletion that orphans whatever pointed at it.
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: Optional one-line heading: a certificate title, a notification subject. Rendered with the same context and the same sandbox as the body.
fields.label: Subject

fields.description: The template body, with {{ placeholders }} filled from the context the calling module builds. Rendered through Frappe's sandboxed Jinja: a template cannot reach Python internals, read the database at will, or execute code.
fields.label: Body

fields.description: What the rendered body is. Returned to the caller as metadata. The render service does not transform on it, so adding a format never changes the renderer.
fields.label: Output Format

fields.description: What this template is for, and which context keys it expects. Notes for the next administrator to edit it.
fields.label: Description
